SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   C. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   B. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   D. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   D. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   B. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   D. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   D. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   D. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Location and size of the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
